dispositions.rationale: simple_sieve allocates exactly n bytes through checked_alloc and immediately initializes exactly n bytes before any indexed access. n is limit + 1 after the function has rejected limit values below 1, and the buffer stores one byte per sieve entry.
dispositions.invariant: isp points to a successful checked_alloc((size_t)n) allocation, and memset receives the identical (size_t)n byte count. This is ordinary initialization, not secret erasure.

dispositions.rationale: sieve_collect derives the packed candidate byte count, normalizes an empty segment to a one-byte allocation, allocates exactly that count through checked_alloc, and initializes the same count before bit access.
dispositions.invariant: bits points to a successful checked_alloc((size_t)bytes) allocation, bytes is at least one on the call path, and memset receives the identical (size_t)bytes count. This is ordinary bitset initialization, not secret erasure.

dispositions.rationale: Comba output initialization. Approval is limited to memory bounds under the documented caller contract; it is not approval of cryptographic correctness.
dispositions.invariant: Validated n is 1..1024. The caller supplies a disjoint 2*n-limb result; zero-fill is exactly 2*n*sizeof(limb_t). Recursive callers provide matching result or scratch segments.

dispositions.rationale: In-place reduction lower half. Approval is limited to memory bounds under the documented caller contract; it is not approval of cryptographic correctness.
dispositions.invariant: product has 2*n limbs by contract. Source [n,2*n) and destination [0,n) are within the same array; memmove is overlap-safe.

dispositions.rationale: Karatsuba scratch initialization. Approval is limited to memory bounds under the documented caller contract; it is not approval of cryptographic correctness.
dispositions.invariant: Count is 1..1024; scratch is 4*n limbs and initialization uses its sizeof. Private recursion consumes S(n)=2*n+S(n/2)<4*n for even n>16; odd/small sizes use Comba.
